title: Dovet — Keep the work. Change the agent. | Agents for Humans
description_lines: A coding agent stops. The files remain. The thread of the work disappears.

Dovet is a local-first recovery supervisor for coding work it explicitly manages. It confirms the original worker stopped, seals an immutable checkpoint, asks a Strands supervisor for a bounded recommendation, applies deterministic authorization policy, and independently verifies the result.
This 2:57 film shows the working local product, real managed Codex interruption evidence, byte-identical checkpoint restoration, durable local service, policy controls, and public evidence surface.

AWS account provisioning blocked every Bedrock text-model invocation before submission. The Strands recovery worker is implemented, but this build records zero successful provider requests and does not claim a live Bedrock recovery or AgentCore deployment. Cloud-dependent moments are labelled in the film.
Built for Agents for Humans — Professional Agents.

The managed interruption and checkpoint evidence are real. The fixture and replay are synthetic and clearly labelled. The opening and closing illustration was generated with OpenAI image generation. The neutral American synthetic narration was produced with Higgsfield. No voice was cloned.
